# Risks and threats

Risks connect engineering decisions to concrete threats and help prioritize
verification coverage.

::: {.need #RISK-001 type="risk" status="in-review" priority="high" tags="security;account-takeover"}
## Account takeover through phishing

A captured credential may enable improper access without a resistant second factor.
:::

::: {.need #RISK-002 type="risk" status="approved" priority="high" tags="security;privilege-escalation"}
## Privilege escalation through permissive policy

A broad or missing policy may grant access beyond the work need.
:::

::: {.need #RISK-003 type="risk" status="approved" priority="high" tags="privacy;audit"}
## Personal-data leakage in logs

Excessively detailed events may expose personal identifiers and attributes.
:::

::: {.need #RISK-004 type="risk" status="draft" priority="medium" tags="availability;recovery"}
## Unavailability during account recovery

A prolonged failure may prevent legitimate users from recovering critical access.
:::
